Pokémon that learn Rain Dance and Sunny Day

22 Jun 2026

Sometimes you want Rain Dance for your rain team and sometimes you want Sunny Day for your sun team. Or maybe you just want to cancel out your opponents’ weather altogether. But what if you wanted both and didn’t have space for two separate Pokémon for each one? Well, you could have the best of both worlds because there are X Pokémon (at the time of writing) that can learn both moves.

I’ve listed them below. This is based on data from Serebii as of Gen 9 (Rain Dance and Sunny Day). If there are any mistakes, let me know.
